{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Theed Palace''' (display name '''Premiere - Theed Palace''') is the constructed pool of printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]], without Players Committee Virtual Sets.<ref name="gemp">GEMP format list, <code>swccgFormats.json</code> (<code>open_no_virtual</code> / "Decipher Cards Only")</ref>

On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] and the Players Committee GEMP table it is the '''Decipher Cards Only''' environment (code <code>open_no_virtual</code>). It covers sets 1&ndash;14 plus the premium and Reflections ids GEMP maps into that environment.<ref name="gemp" />

The [[2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event]] was played in this format.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-05-decipher-cards-only-retro-event/ 2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event], starwarsccg.org</ref> [[Premiere - Reflections III]] is the narrower 2001 Decipher Worlds pool (Premiere through Reflections III only). [[Premiere - Original VS3]] is this printed pool plus original Virtual Sets 1–3, used at the [[2002 World Championship]].
